title: oenothera laciniata var. occidentalis
intro: Oenothera laciniata var. occidentalis, commonly known as Western evening primrose, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Onagraceae family. The health benefits of Western evening primrose include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve symptoms associated with menopause and premenstrual syndrome due to its high levels of gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid. The therapeutic actions of Western evening primrose include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and skin-healing properties, which make it useful in treating eczema, acne, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Western evening primrose include GLA, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for various applications.
